# 📚 Lectures
### Lecture 1: Introduction to Machine Learning
* What is ML? Differences between Supervised, Unsupervised, and Reinforcement Learning
* The ML pipeline: from problem definition to deployment
* Real-world applications (e.g., fraud detection, recommendation engines)
* Setting up the Python environment: Jupyter, Anaconda, virtual environments

### Lecture 2: Math for ML – Linear Algebra & Probability
* Linear Algebra: vectors, matrices, dot product, matrix multiplication
* Probability: basic rules, conditional probability, Bayes’ theorem
* Statistics: expectation, variance, standard deviation, distributions

# 📖 Readings
* DeepLearningBook.org (Ch. 2–3)
* Khan Academy: Linear Algebra & Probability
* Géron: Hands-on ML Ch. 1
